description: This file contains end-to-end test functions for export-related commands in the Mattermost server CLI, including listing, deleting, creating, downloading, showing, listing jobs, and canceling export jobs.

classes.name: MmctlE2ETestSuite
classes.description: Test suite struct for end-to-end testing of export commands in Mattermost CLI.

methods.name: TestExportListCmdF
methods.description: Tests the listing of export files with different permission and state scenarios.

methods.name: TestExportDeleteCmdF
methods.description: Tests deletion of export files, including permission checks and idempotence.

methods.name: TestExportCreateCmdF
methods.description: Tests creation of export jobs with different permission and flag configurations.

methods.name: TestExportDownloadCmdF
methods.description: Tests downloading export files, handling non-existent, existing, and successful download scenarios.

methods.name: TestExportJobShowCmdF
methods.description: Tests retrieving details of specific export jobs, including permission and not found cases.

methods.description: Tests canceling export jobs, including permission and state validation.
